$comment: Provenance of every art asset in the game. Every file under public/art/ must match an entry (tests/content/art-assets.test.ts). No asset was downloaded, traced, generated by an image model, or taken from another game: all of it is original work produced by code in this repository.
projectLicense: No LICENSE file has been chosen for this repository yet, so all rights are reserved by the owner. The assets below are original work made for this project and are covered by whatever licence the owner chooses.

assets.what: Ground layer of the lower market (paving, earth, dry grass, grit, litter, low wall tops, the north city wall), with the shadows and occlusion of every standing thing baked in; morning ('day') and, outdoors, later-day ('late') light, full and half resolution; cut into tiles of at most 2048 px where larger (ground-<light>-x<i>y<j>.webp).
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_place.py from the game's jerusalem-market scene data (tile map, legend, mood, entities). Geometry and materials are procedural (tools/art/lib/*.py): no image textures, scanned or downloaded models, or photographs. Cut into tiles afterwards, without rendering again, by tools/art/upgrade_place.py.

assets.what: Character sprite sheets (idle, breathing, blink, talking, walking, turning; four directions), sheets of people at rest (sitting, lying), sheets with a torn hem, and overlay sheets of story marks (bandages, the spare cloak, a water skin, a lamp, a rolled cloak), with their cast-shadow sheets, for morning, later-day, night, indoor and lamplight light (Chapter 3 adds a newborn lamb held in the arms or the lap, a lamp held up, a wax tablet, and a lamb carried across the shoulders).
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_people.py. Each person is built procedurally from the game's character appearance data (tools/art/lib/people.py): a body grown along a joint skeleton, lofted garments, head and face parts, carried things and story marks, and our own forward kinematics and skinning for every pose. Overlays are rendered with the body as a holdout.

assets.what: Frame layout, origins, appearance keys, poses, marks and overlays of the character sheets.
assets.origin: Written by tools/art/build_people.py.

assets.what: Portraits of every character and player look (head and shoulders, 512 px masters with 256 and 128 px copies) for the dialogue box, the profile picker and chapter select.
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_portraits.py from the characters' appearance data. Heads are sculpted in code as signed distance fields (tools/art/lib/portrait_head.py); skin, eyes, hair (Blender hair curves), cloth and the backdrop are procedural (tools/art/lib/portrait*.py). No image textures, scanned or downloaded models, photographs or image-generation models.
